guarantees.claim: On every rising edge of clk_i, if rst_ni is low, message_length is set to 0; otherwise, it is updated to message_length_d.

assumptions.claim: message_length_d is the correct next value for message_length and is stable at the rising clock edge.
assumptions.cond: always, but critical when HMAC operation depends on message_length
assumptions.risk: If message_length_d contains an incorrect or glitched value, message_length will be corrupted, potentially leading to incorrect HMAC length tracking or state inconsistency.

uncertain_points.claim: The register updates unconditionally every cycle without an enable; it is unclear whether message_length_d is held constant during active HMAC processing or may change mid‑operation.
uncertain_points.cond: When HMAC is processing a message and message_length_d changes unexpectedly.
uncertain_points.risk: If message_length changes during an active HMAC computation, the internal state may use inconsistent message length, leading to incorrect digest or potential security weakness.
